blocks.p: **Sign convention:** measure from the pole or optical centre. The object is on the left. Along the incident light is +, against it is –. Above the axis is +, below is –.

bullets: **Ray rules:** parallel ray → through F (or appears to come from F). Ray through F → parallel. Ray through C (mirror) → returns on itself. Ray through O (lens) → straight on.
**Same-size real image:** object at C (concave mirror) or at 2F_{1} (convex lens).
**Virtual & enlarged:** object between P and F (concave mirror) or between F_{1} and O (convex lens).
**Always virtual, erect, diminished:** convex mirror and concave lens.

blocks.p: Near point 25 cm · far point at infinity · red bends least, violet most · blue sky and red sunsets are due to **scattering** · twinkling stars and the 2-minute early sunrise are due to **atmospheric refraction**.

bullets: Electron charge 1.6 × 10^{-19} C, so 1 C ≈ 6.25 × 10^{18} electrons.
Double the length → R doubles. Double the diameter → R becomes ¼. Stretch to double the length → R becomes 4 times.
n equal resistors R: series gives nR; parallel gives R/n.
A bulb on half its rated voltage uses ¼ of its rated power (P ∝ V^{2} for fixed R).
**Right-hand thumb rule:** thumb along the current → curled fingers show the field.
Force is greatest when the current is ⟂ to the field, and zero when parallel to it.
Domestic wiring: live **red** · neutral **black** · earth **green** · 220 V · 15 A circuit for heavy appliances, 5 A for lights and fans · fuse in the live wire.
